items.title: Dune: Awakening's free Blood and Ice expansion swaps sand for snow on 1st December
items.zh_title: 《Dune: Awakening》免费资料片 Blood and Ice 将于 12 月 1 日把沙漠换成雪原
items.summary: Funcom's survival MMO Dune: Awakening is heading north with a free expansion that trades the deserts of Arrakis for a frozen new map. Read more
items.zh_summary: Funcom 的生存 MMO《Dune: Awakening》将向北进发，推出一个免费资料片，把 Arrakis 的沙漠换成一张冰封的新地图。

items.title: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launches 12th November and a demo is out tomorrow
items.zh_title: 《Pikmin 4》Switch 2 版 11 月 12 日发售，试玩版明天上线
items.summary: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition will launch on 12th November, bundled with a new mode called Dandori Academy. Read more
items.zh_summary: 《Pikmin 4》Switch 2 版将于 11 月 12 日发售，并附带一个名为 Dandori Academy 的新模式。

items.title: The Sunday Papers
items.summary: Sundays are for looking upon my DIY works and despairing. Strewn sawdust, spilled paint, and hunks of broken MDF litter my living room kingdom. When will it be over? When will I be free? When will I b…
items.zh_summary: 周日适合看看家里 DIY 工程的烂摊子再绝望一把，锯末、油漆和碎中密度板铺满客厅，沙发还拼不回去，不过躺在床上倒是可以读一读过去一周关于游戏和游戏之外的好文章。

items.title: PUBG live-action series in the works at Netflix, with Donald Glover set to direct and star
items.zh_title: PUBG 真人剧集将在 Netflix 推出，Donald Glover 将执导并主演
items.summary: PUBG is being turned into a live-action series for Netflix, with Donald Glover set to direct, write, executive produce, and star. Read more
items.zh_summary: PUBG 将被改编成 Netflix 真人剧集，Donald Glover 将担任导演、编剧、执行制片人并主演。
